decision_traceability.decision: Include predefined read-only, tenant-scoped analytics; advanced natural-language analytics and arbitrary text-to-SQL remain out of scope.

Agents directly edit only Subject and Description on accessible tickets; assignment and system-managed fields are denied; status and Category/Priority use separate authorization/workflows; unspecified actions are default-denied.

Persist Category/Priority correction requests with Pending Approval, Approved, and Rejected states, mandatory reason, original value unchanged while pending, authorized Manager/Tenant Admin decisions, eligibility/concurrency controls, audit, UI, APIs, persistence, and tests.

Include job cancellation: Tenant Admin tenant scope; Manager assigned-team scope subject to resource authorization; Agent may cancel initiated jobs while still authorized; queued jobs cancel immediately; processing stops cooperatively; committed completion remains Completed; no partial results; audit, idempotency, concurrency, UI, and required tests.

Persist Agent ticket-cancellation requests with Pending Approval, Approved, and Rejected states; authorized Tenant Admin/assigned-team Manager decisions; required reason/notes; unchanged ticket while pending; eligible-state rules, duplicate prevention, audit, UI, APIs, persistence, and tests.

Allow only the explicit password recovery/change, ticket, knowledge, account, and Platform Admin permission-change email events and recipients; preserve authorization, privacy, deduplication, bounded retries, audit, and truthful delivery status; no unlisted event without explicit approval.

Preserve default-deny authorization, tenant/team/resource checks, audit, concurrency safety, non-exposure of sensitive or partial results, and mandatory automated testing; no functional deferrals for the approved additions.
